author: ImRaging
body:
Well, I must admit the evidence did look fishy. I offered an ss a couple of times but i was declined since it was too late after 5mins (fair enough). I honestly don't know what to say. I don't have to come clean, I can't fess up. All I can say is that I didn't hack. I've never downloaded a hacked client. The only 'cheat' i've ever had is razer synapse right autoclicker (to practise the breezily movement on single player). I feel quite sad right now, I myself know i don't hack but i can't prove it to you now.

I guess this is up to the opinions of mods. I'd also like to request that mods in Apollo and PPB not to be included as bias and all that, including Hete even though he was the one to ban me.

I hope this is considered, Raging.

title: ImRaging (Razeh) Anti-KB Appeal

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hello Raging,

The evidence for your ban has been deemed inconclusive and I and other members of the staff team have decided that you shall be appealed.

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie, Senior Moderator
